submitted.rationale: I measured five points spread across the Zn-Sb-O line (Sb 0.24, 0.50, 0.64, 0.76, 0.93). All EQE values are between -0.0015% and 0.0011%. That looks like noise, which fits wide-gap Zn antimonates (ZnSb2O6 ~3.3 eV, Zn7Sb2O12) barely responding to 2.4 eV photons. Index 25 has the highest measured value (0.00113%), but it is not clearly better than the others.

rejected.reason: Near ZnSb2O6 (Sb 0.667), but EQE was 0.00092%, about zero.
Middle of the line; EQE was 0.00095%, below index 25.
